title: Choose the visual world for the Tanod app
question: The roll assigned Jeepney Route Board. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Jeepney Route Board
options.lineage: Painted jeepney signboards and livery stripes of Bicol roads
options.thesis: Every call reads like the route board on the front of a jeepney: where you are going, in letters you can read from across the road.
materials: livery stripes in red, yellow and blue
options.viewport: Material top bar and navigation bar; under the bar a white route board carries the active call (INC-2026-067, Service lane, Dao, 29 km S) in big condensed letters, with the four dispatch stages painted beneath it as stops; duty card, Report and a separated SOS below.
options.risk: Can tip into folk kitsch if the stripes spread beyond the route board and state colours.

raised.raise: A changed call or stage stays lit on the board until the tanod opens it, never silently replaced.
Livery red is reserved for the active call and SOS only; nothing else may use it.
One sign face for every headline and one workhorse face for everything else, no third voice.

options.label: Tanod Reflective Vest
options.lineage: The navy tanod vest with its reflective silver band and yellow TANOD print
options.thesis: The app wears the uniform: a navy shell with one reflective band that lights up when you are on duty.
options.viewport: Navy top bar; a silver reflective band runs under it showing duty state and GPS; the active call card sits on light ground below, SOS separated at the foot.
options.risk: Navy plus safety yellow is the look most public-safety apps land on; distinct only if the band is truly the duty signal.

options.label: Terminal Yellow Wayfinding
options.lineage: Airport overhead sign bands: yellow panels, black humanist letters, pictograms
options.thesis: Each screen shows only the next decision on a yellow band, with distance and direction set large.
options.viewport: A yellow band under the top bar: Next, INC-2026-067, 29 km S, with an arrow locked to its edge; everything else neutral.
options.case: Fuses cleanly (a dispatch is a decision point) and wins on clarity, but airport signs are not the tanods' world.
options.risk: Yellow on a cheap screen in sun can wash out; reads as transit, not barangay.

options.label: Boarding Pass and Gate Board
options.lineage: Segmented boarding pass beside a live gate board
options.thesis: Dispatches as a departures board that reranks in place.
options.viewport: Dispatch list as a gate board; the active call as a pass.
options.case: Tanods rarely fly; the board metaphor adds reading time.
options.kept: A changed row stays lit until noticed.

options.label: Orienteering Map
options.lineage: ISOM orienteering maps with the course in purple
options.thesis: The route rides in one reserved colour over the terrain.
options.viewport: Map-first home with the active leg in purple.
options.case: Unknown sport locally; map-first slows the Home tasks.
options.kept: One colour reserved for the active leg only.

options.label: Design Annual Plate Section
options.lineage: Design annual plates with registration marks
options.thesis: A gallery sheet with hairlines and one grotesque.
options.case: Gallery calm is wrong for a call in progress.

options.label: Darkroom Exposure Record
options.case: Hatching cannot be read at a glance in sun.
options.kept: Tonal steps as the only greys.

options.label: Convention Circle Catalog
options.thesis: Stamp-size cells on a hall grid.
options.kept: Visited items struck through, not hidden.

canonCard.label: Material 3, played straight
canonCard.thesis: A stock Material You app: tonal blue scheme, standard cards, chips and a FAB.
canonCard.viewport: Top app bar, the active call as a filled card, duty card, extended FAB for Report, SOS as an error-coloured button.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any Android utility app by design.
